title: R&D Engineer 3, Software
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

We are looking for a Senior Observability Engineer to design, build, and continuously improve monitoring and observability for our enterprise environment. Most of the work focuses on on-premises systems: physical servers, virtualized infrastructure, and on-prem Kubernetes clusters, along with the infrastructure layers underneath them. Some cloud use cases are also in scope. Your goal is to give system owners and business stakeholders an accurate, actionable view of the health and uptime of the systems they depend on.  
You will also help shape how we apply agentic AI to observability, moving from dashboards and alerts toward intelligent triage, correlation, and assisted remediation.

  
Responsibilities:

Architecture and Design

* Design end-to-end monitoring and observability solutions for enterprise applications running on VMs, Kubernetes, and bare-metal servers, and extend them to cloud workloads where needed.
* Define a layered monitoring strategy that covers hardware, OS, virtualization, network, storage, platform services, and applications.
* Set standards for metrics, logs, alerting, dashboards, and service health models, including SLIs and SLOs where they apply.
* Make sound architectural decisions on tool roles, data flows, retention, scalability, and high availability across the observability stack.
* Define alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Design service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Secure observability platforms and integrations through access controls, authentication, encryption, and vulnerability remediation. Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards through platform hardening, audit readiness, and regular security reviews.

Implementation

* Build and maintain monitoring with Zabbix, covering templates, discovery, triggers, proxies, and integrations.
* Design and maintain log collection, parsing, enrichment, and routing pipelines into Splunk, including forwarders, sourcetypes, field extractions, indexes, and searches.
* Contribute to metrics and visualization with Prometheus and Grafana, particularly for Kubernetes workloads and unified dashboards.
* Automate the configuration and onboarding of monitoring using infrastructure-as-code and APIs.

Agentic AI for Observability

* Design and implement AI agents that support observability workflows. Examples include alert triage and deduplication, cross-source event correlation, root-cause hypotheses, incident summarization, and runbook-driven remediation with human-in-the-loop approval.
* Integrate LLM-based agents with monitoring and logging platforms through APIs and tool protocols such as MCP.
* Define guardrails, permission boundaries, and auditability for AI-driven actions on production systems.
* Measure the real impact of these agents on operations, for example on MTTD, MTTR, alert noise, and on-call load.

Collaboration

* Work closely with system owners to understand architecture, failure modes, and dependencies, and to translate them into meaningful monitoring.
* Partner with consumers and stakeholders of those systems to define what “healthy” and “available” mean to them, and to make sure observability gives them the visibility they need.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, and run knowledge sharing across operations, infrastructure, and development teams.

Continuous Improvement

* Regularly review alert quality, coverage gaps, and signal-to-noise ratio, and tune or retire monitoring accordingly.
* Use incidents and post-mortems as input to improve detection and response.
* Track the evolution of the observability toolset and the wider technology landscape.

Qualifications:

Required

* 7+ years in infrastructure, operations, or observability engineering, with at least 3 years focused on monitoring and observability, primarily in on-premises enterprise environments.
* Hands-on, production-level experience with Zabbix and Splunk.
* Proven experience monitoring physical servers, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Kubernetes clusters.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure layers: compute, OS (Linux and Windows), networking, storage, and the dependencies between them.
* Solid experience with log collection and processing at scale: parsing, normalization, enrichment, retention, and search optimization.
* Practical experience applying agentic AI (LLM agents, tool use, automation) to monitoring, operations, or incident management, along with a working understanding of how these systems behave and where their risks lie.
* Experience designing monitoring architecture, not only operating existing tools.
* Experience defining alert escalation policies, incident response workflows, and event correlation strategies to reduce operational noise and improve service reliability.
* Experience designing service topology, dependency mapping, and business service monitoring across infrastructure and application layers.
* Working knowledge of securing observability platforms, including access control, authentication, encryption, and hardening.
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and comfort working with REST APIs.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work with both technical owners and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

* Experience with Prometheus (exporters, alerting rules, Alert manager, long-term storage).
* Experience with Grafana (dashboard design, multi-source visualization, alerting).
* Experience monitoring cloud workloads (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid environments.
* Software development experience, such as building integrations, tools, exporters, or services.

description:

This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

**We offer**

You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

In this role as a QA Automation Expert, you will independently drive complex quality engineering and test automation initiatives across cloud\-native, distributed, and AI\-enabled applications. You will have the opportunity to build scalable automation solutions, solve challenging testing problems, contribute to automation and engineering improvements, and leverage modern technologies including Playwright, AWS/GCP, CI/CD, and AI\-assisted testing to enhance quality engineering effectiveness.

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We’re a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow’s technology solutions.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Senior Specialist
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The **Global Digital Marketing Automation Senior Specialist** is a deep, day\-to\-day expert in Marketo (or an equivalent platform such as Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot) who owns and optimizes our marketing automation engine. You’ll manage everything from advanced campaign builds and third\-party integrations to lead lifecycle strategy, event operations, and data governance — acting as the platform’s subject matter expert across the organization.


This is an ideal role for someone who has moved beyond basic email sends and wants to own the architecture, personalization, and performance of a marketing automation instance end\-to\-end.

 **Platform Management \& Campaign Execution**

* Manage, build, and optimize advanced Marketo core assets daily, including Smart Campaigns, Programs, Smart Lists, and flow logic
* Build and maintain universal, advanced Marketo Forms with progressive profiling, UTM parameter capture, hidden fields, and custom JavaScript for use across multiple workspaces
* Design and deploy standard landing page templates integrated with social sharing/network components
* Create reusable snippets for standardized footers and modular content blocks across landing pages and emails

 **Integrations \& Tech Stack**

* Integrate and manage third\-party platforms within Marketo, including webinar/virtual event tools (Zoom, ON24\), event registration platforms (Aventri, Certain), and mobile push notification channels
* Work with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics, ensuring seamless lead/contact flow, field mapping, and sync configuration between Marketo and the CRM
* Troubleshoot CRM–Marketo sync issues (e.g., sync errors, field mismatches, duplicate records, blocked syncs) and implement fixes to maintain reliable, real\-time data flow \- Apply data enrichment practices — using enrichment tools, form\-based progressive profiling, and third\-party data append — to keep lead and contact records complete and up to date
* Demonstrate strong API familiarity, including configuring and managing API user roles/permissions, working with REST APIs for platform integrations, and troubleshooting API\- based data exchanges
* Test new services, integrations, and platform updates prior to launch

**Lead Lifecycle: Nurturing, Scoring \& Personalization**

* Build and maintain lead nurturing and lead scoring programs at both the global/instance level and individual campaign level
* Design and execute web personalization campaigns using dynamic content, web campaigns, and audience segments
* Develop lifecycle models and continuously refine scoring frameworks to improve lead quality and MQL conversion

**Data Management \& Segmentatio****n**

* Define and maintain audience segmentation strategies at both the client/account level and individual project level
* Own database hygiene, list imports, and data quality processes to maintain a clean, actionable database
* Support governance and documentation standards for data usage across programs

**Events \& Content Programs**

* Manage end\-to\-end program setup for trade shows, including personalized agendas and dynamic imagery per attendee/segment
* Build and manage webinar, online event, and gated content programs, including registration, reminder, and follow\-up flows
* Own program status tracking and post\-event hygiene (e.g., processing attendee/lead downloads, deduplication, list cleanup)

**Enablement, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as subject\-matter expert (SME) for the marketing automation platform, supporting troubleshooting, consultations, and new project readiness
* Provide training and documentation to internal teams, marketing ops representatives, and business stakeholders
* Partner with stakeholders to define requirements, governance standards, and rollout plans for new pilots or workspaces
* Support onboarding of new projects/workspaces onto the platform, including QA and functionality testing

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4–7 years of hands\-on experience managing a marketing automation platform (Marketo strongly preferred; Eloqua, Pardot, or HubSpot experience also considered)
* Marketo Certified Expert certification preferred (or willingness to obtain)
* Proven experience building advanced Smart Campaigns, Programs, and multi\-step nurture/lead scoring logic
* Experience integrating Marketo with third\-party tools (webinar platforms, event management tools, CRM, mobile/push notification systems)
* Working knowledge of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), including lead/contact sync configuration and troubleshooting CRM–Marketo data flow issues
* Familiarity with data enrichment tools and practices to maintain accurate and complete records
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Experience with progressive profiling, dynamic/personalized content, and web segmentation
* Solid understanding of database segmentation, list hygiene, and data governance best practices
* Experience managing event marketing programs (webinars, trade shows, gated content) end\-to\-end
* Familiarity with Git or a similar version control tool (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) for tracking changes to custom scripts, JavaScript used in forms/landing pages, and code\-based assets
* Nice to have:
* Experience with Zoom, ON24, Aventri, or Certain integrations
* Experience supporting global, multi\-region marketing operations
* Exposure to lifecycle model design and cross\-functional campaign governance
* A/B testing and campaign performance reporting experience
* Exposure to CI/CD deployment practices for managing and releasing code\-based assets (custom scripts, templates,
* integrations) in a structured, version\-controlled way

  

Who You'll Work With


You will work within a Global Digital Marketing Automation and Email platform team across multiple geographies, collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, and platform teams. This role offers the opportunity to directly shape internal tools used globally across BCG.

  

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT** :

* Working with APIs — understanding of REST API concepts, managing API user roles/permissions, and supporting API\-driven integrations
* Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive/media\-query email template design
* Strong communication skills with experience training stakeholders and documenting processes
* Detail\-oriented, process\-driven, and comfortable owning platform QA/testing before launches

 *"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*

*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*

*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."*
